custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View and See Financial Data off, so user B cannot see prices.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with Sell Price $20.00, then change its Sell Price to 23.45, so its Part History holds a price entry.
  • Start window 1 on part A's Part History page (the clock icon at the left of its row).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425780-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425780-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • To create a custom role: Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type the Role Name; switch on Parts Department, then tick the boxes the setup names on its three rows, Part sales, Part Library and Inventory, and Vendor and order management (each has View, Create & Edit and Delete); See Financial Data is under Cross-Cutting Toggles; then click Create. (The setup above writes these boxes as, for example, Part Library & Inventory — View, which is the View box on the Part Library and Inventory row.)
  • User B: the QA site's sign-in screen offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B for this test. Signed in as Admin: Settings, then Staff in the left menu; click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick role B under Role and click Save & Close. Then, in the second (private) window, choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way, because other testers use that sign-in.

Step 1:

  • The price entry is listed for the Admin.

Step 2:

  • Part A's Part History opens for user B.

Step 3:

  • No entry is found for user B by the price.

Step 4:

  • User B's list shows part A's entries again, the price entry among them: only the price search was refused.
